0022600155.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-4, on a three-game losing streak and 0-2 at home) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-5, on a five-game losing streak and 0-3 at home) in the Pacers' seventh game of the season, with Indiana 12th in the East and three games back in the Central, and Brooklyn 15th in the East and five games back in the Atlantic. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The Pacers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 136-109 win in Brooklyn on October 25, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
